title: Problem Decomposition
intent: formative · Intellectual Depth (Thinking) · click through the process
statement: Take a huge, ill-defined problem and break it into manageable, testable sub-components you can actually work on.

steps.title: Name the whole problem
steps.text: State the big problem plainly, in one sentence, before you cut it up.

steps.title: Split into sub-problems
steps.text: Break it into parts that are smaller, clearer and separable from each other.

steps.title: Make each piece testable
steps.text: Rewrite each part so progress on it can be checked — vague parts hide the real work.

steps.title: Order by dependency
steps.text: Find which pieces must be solved before others, and sequence them accordingly.

steps.title: Pick the first tractable piece
steps.text: Choose the smallest part that moves the whole forward, and start there.

feedForward.text: Take your assignment topic and write three sub-questions, each narrow enough to answer in a paragraph.
